title: Answer: neural representation, not the sentential model of folk psychology

statements.text: The view has no general theory of information. It holds that representational states are not to be modeled on propositional attitudes: the lack of another way to characterize them is a limit of folk psychology, not of the creatures that have representations.

sources.quote: but this should properly be seen as a limitation on folk psychology, rather than a limitation on what kind of creatures have representations
